comparison.objective: Measure shaft end play, choose a spacer and verify the fitted shaft; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a contact indicator, move a shaft between stops, interpret a tolerance table and install a split spacer versus manipulate a setscrew and collar and run impact trials.
comparison.success_condition: Correct clearance and free rotation after fitting, rejecting thin or oversized spacers, versus two force-, travel-, rebound- and drift-compliant stops.
comparison.reason: Both use measurement-driven mechanical work, but discrete tolerance fitting and post-fit rotation test a different ability from iterative energy-dissipation adjustment.
